info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Payments Payments Charge-v1-spec
info.description: The Batch Payment Processing API enables businesses to efficiently process multiple payment transactions in a single request. This endpoint allows for the submission of payment charges, streamlining the payment workflow for applications that require bulk processing capabilities. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and financial services apps that handle large volumes of transactions. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance transaction throughput and improve user experience during payment operations.

post.summary: Charge a payment using the provided details.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to process a payment by charging the specified amounts to a chosen payment method. Ensure that all required payment fields are correctly populated to facilitate a smooth transaction.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a charge payment. It requires specific details about the payment, including the amount and payment method. Ensure that all necessary fields are populated correctly before sending the request.
